title: Abdul El-Sayed Joins Jesse Watters of Fox News for Some Light Verbal Combat
summary: In a smiling yet tense interview, Dr. Abdul El-Sayed, the Democratic nominee for Senate in Michigan, argued that his Republican critics were using culture-war issues to distract from Americans’ economic concerns.
